messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Access defined parameters?
parts:
On 11/05/2012 05:17 PM, Felix Sch�nbrodt wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> is there a way to access defined parameters (like ab := a*b)?
> They do not show up in the coef() function, and I could not find any
> other way ...

parameterEstimates(fit)

will always show the defined parameters. Another option is:

coef(fit, type="user")

which is a bit hard to find in the documentation. You can find a vague
description of it in the man page for the lavaan methods: type (in R):

class?lavaan

and look at the 'Methods' section.

Yves.

Following the posts in this thread, is there a way to extract only defined parameters, sth like coef(fit, type="definedPar"). messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Access defined parameters?
parts:
On 02/14/2014 12:47 PM, JB wrote:
> Dear all,
> Following the posts in this thread, is there a way to extract only
> defined parameters, sth like coef(fit, type="definedPar"). I have a
> model with many parameters but I want to bootstrap only the parameters
> that I defined; I though the boostrap might be a little bit quicker and
> the output more readable if I could extract only the defined parameters.

It will not be quicker. The only way to extract 'only' the defined
parameters is to use indices (eg coef(fit)[12:16] )

Yves.
